entries.title: Random Coil to Folded Helix Playground
entries.description: A chain of connected spheres (amino acids) wiggles randomly in 3D, then gradually snaps into an alpha-helix as certain colored beads attract, with labels on residues and fading trails showing their paths.

entries.title: Hydrophobic Collapse in a Water Box
entries.description: A flexible chain of spheres with hydrophobic (yellow) and hydrophilic (blue) beads drifts in a transparent box filled with tiny water particles that bounce and push the chain until hydrophobic beads cluster in the center and hydrophilic beads face outward.
entries.seed: Hydrophobic Collapse in a Water Box: A flexible chain of spheres with hydrophobic (yellow) and hydrophilic (blue) beads drifts in a transparent box filled with tiny water particles that bounce and push the chain until hydrophobic beads cluster in the center and hydrophilic beads face outward.

entries.title: Chaperonin Folding Chamber
entries.description: A hollow cylindrical “chaperone” cage opens and closes while a floppy chain enters, folds inside, and exits more compact, with the cage walls pulsing color to show active vs. inactive states and labels marking entrance/exit.
entries.seed: Chaperonin Folding Chamber: A hollow cylindrical “chaperone” cage opens and closes while a floppy chain enters, folds inside, and exits more compact, with the cage walls pulsing color to show active vs. inactive states and labels marking entrance/exit.

entries.title: Energy Landscape Funnel
entries.description: A single moving “protein” sphere rolls over a 3D landscape of hills and valleys (mesh surface) labeled as energy levels, leaving a trail as it funnels into the deepest valley representing the native folded state.

entries.title: Misfolding and Aggregation Cluster
entries.description: Multiple chains fold; some correctly collapse into compact shapes while others misfold into sticky exposed patches that cause them to attach and grow into a branching aggregate cluster that slowly enlarges and darkens.

entries.title: Protein Domain Hinges and Rotations
entries.description: A protein built from three rigid colored blocks connected by flexible joints rotates and bends at the joints, demonstrating domain motions; labels show angles and a transparent plane shows how far each domain swings.

entries.title: Secondary Structure Formation Timeline
entries.description: A long polypeptide ribbon starts as a random coil and gradually segments into red helices and flat blue sheets that appear, rotate into position, and lock together while residue indices float as small labels along the backbone.
entries.seed: Secondary Structure Formation Timeline: A long polypeptide ribbon starts as a random coil and gradually segments into red helices and flat blue sheets that appear, rotate into position, and lock together while residue indices float as small labels along the backbone.

entries.title: Temperature-Driven Unfolding and Refolding
entries.description: A folded protein model trembles gently at low temperature, then as a temperature meter rises its structure vibrates more, helices unwind and loops extend, and when the meter drops again the chain attempts to refold, sometimes into alternate conformations.

entries.title: Protein-Ligand Induced Fit
entries.description: A folded protein with a flexible binding pocket sits stationary while a small glowing ligand sphere diffuses around, occasionally colliding and entering the pocket; when it binds, nearby side-chain beads rotate and shift to wrap around it.

entries.title: Co-Translational Folding from a Ribosome Tunnel
entries.description: A ribosome represented by large static rings extrudes a growing chain of beads through a narrow tunnel; the emerging segment starts folding into helices and loops as new beads are added at the exit, with a timer and length counter.

Here are strong **Protein folding simulation inputs** you can plug into your prompt:

1. **Random Coil to Folded Helix Playground**
   A chain of connected spheres (amino acids) wiggles randomly in 3D, then gradually snaps into an alpha-helix as certain colored beads attract, with labels on residues and fading trails showing their paths.

2. **Hydrophobic Collapse in a Water Box**
   A flexible chain of spheres with hydrophobic (yellow) and hydrophilic (blue) beads drifts in a transparent box filled with tiny water particles that bounce and push the chain until hydrophobic beads cluster in the center and hydrophilic beads face outward.

3. **Chaperonin Folding Chamber**
   A hollow cylindrical “chaperone” cage opens and closes while a floppy chain enters, folds inside, and exits more compact, with the cage walls pulsing color to show active vs. inactive states and labels marking entrance/exit.

4. **Energy Landscape Funnel**
   A single moving “protein” sphere rolls over a 3D landscape of hills and valleys (mesh surface) labeled as energy levels, leaving a trail as it funnels into the deepest valley representing the native folded state.

5. **Misfolding and Aggregation Cluster**
   Multiple chains fold; some correctly collapse into compact shapes while others misfold into sticky exposed patches that cause them to attach and grow into a branching aggregate cluster that slowly enlarges and darkens.

6. **Protein Domain Hinges and Rotations**

8. **Temperature-Driven Unfolding and Refolding**
   A folded protein model trembles gently at low temperature, then as a temperature meter rises its structure vibrates more, helices unwind and loops extend, and when the meter drops again the chain attempts to refold, sometimes into alternate conformations.
